author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Zoom Contact Center operation logs and voice call logs. The example bridge in bridges/zoom-report-logs polls them from the Zoom Contact Center API and posts them to HTTP Ingest. Operation logs go to CloudAudit and voice calls stay in Generic through the parent.
notes:
Setup:
- The example bridge in bridges/zoom-report-logs polls Zoom Contact Center operation logs and voice call logs from the Zoom Contact Center API (set ZOOM_REPORTS to cc_operation_logs,cc_voice_calls) and posts them to HTTP Ingest.
- Use a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only contact_center:read:operation_logs:admin and contact_center:read:voice_call_log:admin.
- The bridge puts "zoom_record" first (cc_operation or cc_voice_call) and adds account_id.

Field mapping:
- Operation logs go to CloudAudit with the action as the event name, the category as the event type, the operator as the user, the object as the resource and operation_log_id as the event ID.
- Unmask, Download, Listen and Export read customer data or recordings, so they are read-only data events; every other action is a management event.
- Operation logs carry no IP address.
- Voice calls fit no schema, so they stay in Generic through the parent, with the engagement ID as the event ID and the call's start as the event time.

Time:
- The bridge asks for UTC, so voice call times end in +00:00.

Sources and licenses:
- Zoom documents the operation log fields, its action list and one example (Account, Create, "Add Flows: [inbox-voicemail]").

Made up in the samples:
- The categories, objects and details in the samples are made up in that shape, since Zoom's category table wasn't reachable.
- Voice call samples follow the response in Zoom's reference with made-up values.

Testing:
- The child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22 (63 of 63 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there.
- The child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (54 of 54 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs), and the parent alone matched every voice call record.
- No built-in parser claimed these records in 3 runs.

Known gaps:
- Agent IP and SBC fields appear only once Zoom Support turns on a flag for the account.
